task_description: Upgrade the Coinscribed.com homepage to a news-first, competitor-inspired layout (CoinDesk/NerdWallet/Bankrate style). Reorder so News comes before Calculators, and add: a LIVE crypto price ticker (CoinGecko, client-side, 60s refresh, graceful fallback), a featured hero article + headlines sidebar, a market data widget (illustrative static index values), a trust-signals stat section, an image-rich upgrade to news cards (category-colored gradient placeholders), and a newsletter signup section (UI-only with client-side success). Keep the teal (#0f766e) + amber (#b45309) palette, serif+sans typography, and full responsive/dark-mode support.

verification.summary: npm run build exits 0 with no type errors (postbuild next-sitemap runs normally); npm run lint reports no warnings/errors. Project has no automated test suite (test_quality assessed by reading the new components). CryptoTicker verified to fetch live CoinGecko data client-side in useEffect with a 60s setInterval and a realistic static fallback used on initial render and on any fetch error/non-ok/partial response, so it never breaks the page. No Docker (no Dockerfile; Next.js app deploys to Vercel), so docker_build skipped. Homepage section order confirmed news-first: CryptoTicker -> Featured hero + sidebar -> MarketDataWidget -> Latest News grid -> TrustSignals -> Calculators -> Bank Routing Numbers -> NewsletterSignup.
